info.name: Bug Evidence – LABcourse (15 Bugs)
info.description:
INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Make sure your backend is running on localhost:5000
2. Import this file into Postman (File → Import)
3. Open the '0. Setup' folder and RUN ALL THREE login requests in order (they save tokens automatically)
4. Run each BUG-XXX request and take a screenshot showing the URL, status code, and response body

For file-upload bugs (BUG-006, BUG-009, BUG-010): see the request description for which file to select.

item.name: BUG-001 – ENUM mismatch: lab request returns 500

request.description:
Expected: 201 Created
Actual: 500 Internal Server Error

Root cause: code sets status='pending' but DB ENUM has no such value (uses 'Pending' with capital P).

Expected: 201 Created
Actual: 500 – Unknown column 'patient.first_name' in 'field list'

Root cause: IPDDoctorService.js queries User model with first_name/last_name which do not exist on the users table.

item.name: BUG-003 – Invalid email returns 500 instead of 400

request.description:
Expected: 400 Bad Request (invalid email format)
Actual: 500 Internal Server Error

Root cause: SequelizeValidationError not caught — falls through to generic 500 handler.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (password too short)
Actual: 200 OK — account created with only 5 characters

Root cause: no minimum password length validation in signup handler.

item.name: BUG-005 – Unavailable doctor can still be booked

request.description:
Expected: 400 Bad Request (doctor not available)
Actual: 201 Created — appointment booked even though doctor 14 has available=false in DB

Root cause: createAppointment() performs no availability check.

item.name: BUG-006 – Wrong file type returns 500 instead of 400  [FILE UPLOAD]

formdata.description: SELECT ANY .jpg OR .png FILE from your computer here

request.description:
HOW TO RUN IN POSTMAN:
1. Click on 'Body' tab → 'form-data'
2. Set Key = result_pdf, Type = File
3. Click 'Select Files' and choose any .jpg or .png file
4. Send

Expected: 400 Bad Request (only PDF allowed)
Actual: 500 Internal Server Error

Root cause: Multer fileFilter calls cb(new Error('Only PDF files are allowed')) which propagates to the global 500 handler.

item.name: BUG-007 – Appointment 4m59s in future accepted (no min-time check)

exec: // Compute a timestamp exactly 4 minutes and 59 seconds from now

request.description:
The pre-request script auto-computes a timestamp 4 min 59 sec from now.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (must book at least 5 minutes ahead)
Actual: 201 Created

Root cause: no minimum advance-booking time check in createAppointment().

Expected: 400 Bad Request (cannot book in the past)
Actual: 201 Created with scheduled_for: 2020-01-01

Root cause: no past-date validation in createAppointment().

item.name: BUG-009 – Exactly 10 MB PDF rejected (boundary value error)  [FILE UPLOAD]

formdata.description: SELECT a PDF file that is EXACTLY 10 MB (10,485,760 bytes). See instructions below.

request.description:
HOW TO CREATE THE 10 MB TEST FILE (run once in PowerShell/Terminal):
  node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const h=Buffer.from('%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj\n<<>>\nendobj\n'); const f=Buffer.from('\n%%EOF\n'); const p=Buffer.alloc(10*1024*1024-h.length-f.length,37); fs.writeFileSync('C:/tmp/exact10mb.pdf',Buffer.concat([h,p,f])); console.log('done');"

Then select C:/tmp/exact10mb.pdf in Postman.

Expected: 200 OK (10 MB is the maximum, boundary should be ACCEPTED)
Actual: 500 – 'File too large'

Root cause: Multer limit is < 10 MB exclusive, so exactly 10 MB is rejected. Also, LIMIT_FILE_SIZE returns 500 instead of 413.

item.name: BUG-010 – Over 10 MB PDF returns 500 instead of 413  [FILE UPLOAD]

formdata.description: SELECT a PDF file larger than 10 MB (~10.5 MB). See instructions below.

request.description:
HOW TO CREATE THE 10.5 MB TEST FILE (run once in PowerShell/Terminal):
  node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const h=Buffer.from('%PDF-1.4\n1 0 obj\n<<>>\nendobj\n'); const f=Buffer.from('\n%%EOF\n'); const p=Buffer.alloc(10*1024*1024+512*1024-h.length-f.length,37); fs.writeFileSync('C:/tmp/over10mb.pdf',Buffer.concat([h,p,f])); console.log('done');"

Then select C:/tmp/over10mb.pdf in Postman.

Expected: 413 Request Entity Too Large
Actual: 500 Internal Server Error

Root cause: Multer LIMIT_FILE_SIZE error is not handled — falls through to generic 500 handler.

exec: // Build a 501-char string and set tomorrow's timestamp

request.description:
The pre-request script builds a 501-character reason string automatically.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (reason exceeds 500 characters)
Actual: 500 Internal Server Error

Root cause: Appointment.reason is STRING(500); 501-char input hits DB VARCHAR(500) limit — error falls through to 500 handler instead of being validated first.

item.name: BUG-012 – Doctor role can book appointment (RBAC missing on POST /appointments/)

request.description:
Using DOCTOR token (not patient).

Expected: 403 Forbidden (only patients should book appointments)
Actual: 201 Created — doctor successfully books an appointment

Root cause: POST /appointments/ has no role-check middleware — any authenticated user can book.

item.name: BUG-013 – Patient changes PENDING→APPROVED (no role check on PUT)

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + '/api/appointments/', method: 'GET' }, function(err, res) {
if (err) { console.error('Error fetching appointments:', err); return; }
console.log('No PENDING found – using fallback ID 18. Update manually if needed.');

request.description:
Using PATIENT token.
The pre-request script auto-finds a PENDING appointment ID.

Expected: 403 Forbidden (only doctors should be able to approve appointments)
Actual: 200 OK — patient successfully changed status to APPROVED

Root cause: PUT /appointments/:id has no role-check middleware.

item.name: BUG-014 – Doctor reverts COMPLETED→PENDING (no terminal-state guard)

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + '/api/appointments/', method: 'GET' }, function(err, res) {
if (err) { console.error('Error fetching appointments:', err); return; }
console.log('No COMPLETED found – using fallback ID 1. Update manually if needed.');

request.description:
Using DOCTOR token.
The pre-request script auto-finds a COMPLETED appointment ID.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (COMPLETED is a terminal state — transitions are not allowed)
Actual: 200 OK — appointment reverted to PENDING

Root cause: updateAppointment() has no terminal-state guard.

item.name: BUG-015 – Doctor changes DECLINED→CONFIRMED (no terminal-state guard)

exec: pm.sendRequest({ url: baseUrl + '/api/appointments/', method: 'GET' }, function(err, res) {
if (err) { console.error('Error fetching appointments:', err); return; }
console.log('No DECLINED found – using fallback ID 34. Update manually if needed.');

request.description:
Using DOCTOR token.
The pre-request script auto-finds a DECLINED appointment ID.

Expected: 400 Bad Request (DECLINED is a terminal state — transitions are not allowed)
Actual: 200 OK — appointment changed to CONFIRMED

Root cause: updateAppointment() has no terminal-state guard.
